what: fold-6 label sets of the same protein as an entry PLM-CS trained on
rule: a fold-6 label set is withheld from PLM-CS if any RefDB entry PLM-CS trained on is the same BMRB, shares a UniProt accession under our build's mapping, or aligns at >=95% identity over >=90% of the shorter sequence
corpus: the released RefDB snapshot SHIFTX2 ships (DEEPSHIFT_REFDB_LIBRARY)
